pattern: join on two keys and derive one measure from each table
question: for 2023 combine both files and calculate ANC coverage and employed out of enrolled percentage for each district
gold_sql: SELECT a.district, ROUND(100.0 * a.anc4_completed / a.pregnancies_registered, 1) AS anc_percent, ROUND(100.0 * l.employed_at_6_months / l.women_enrolled, 1) AS employment_percent FROM anc_visits AS a INNER JOIN livelihoods AS l ON a.district = l.district AND a.year = l.year WHERE a.year = 2023 ORDER BY a.district
sql_duckdb: WITH anc AS (SELECT district, year, pregnancies_registered, anc4_completed FROM anc_visits WHERE year = 2023), livelihoods AS (SELECT district, year, women_enrolled, employed_at_6_months FROM livelihoods WHERE year = 2023) SELECT COALESCE(a.district, l.district) AS district, a.pregnancies_registered, a.anc4_completed, CASE WHEN a.pregnancies_registered IS NULL OR a.pregnancies_registered = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (a.anc4_completed * 100.0) / NULLIF(a.pregnancies_registered, 0) END AS anc_coverage_percentage, l.women_enrolled, l.employed_at_6_months, CASE WHEN l.women_enrolled IS NULL OR l.women_enrolled = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (l.employed_at_6_months * 100.0) / NULLIF(l.women_enrolled, 0) END AS employed_out_of_enrolled_percentage FROM anc AS a FULL OUTER JOIN livelihoods AS l ON a.district = l.district AND a.year = l.year ORDER BY COALESCE(a.district, l.district) NULLS FIRST

CURRENT QUESTION:
for 2023 combine both files and calculate ANC coverage and employed out of enrolled percentage for each district
attempts.response:
```sql
WITH anc AS (
    SELECT
        district,
        year,
        pregnancies_registered,
        anc4_completed
    FROM anc_visits
    WHERE year = 2023
),
livelihoods AS (
    SELECT
        district,
        year,
        women_enrolled,
        employed_at_6_months
    FROM livelihoods
    WHERE year = 2023
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(a.district, l.district) AS district,
    a.pregnancies_registered,
    a.anc4_completed,
    CASE
        WHEN a.pregnancies_registered IS NULL OR a.pregnancies_registered = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE (a.anc4_completed * 100.0) / a.pregnancies_registered
    END AS anc_coverage_percentage,
    l.women_enrolled,
    l.employed_at_6_months,
    CASE
        WHEN l.women_enrolled IS NULL OR l.women_enrolled = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE (l.employed_at_6_months * 100.0) / l.women_enrolled
    END AS employed_out_of_enrolled_percentage
FROM anc a
FULL OUTER JOIN livelihoods l
    ON a.district = l.district
    AND a.year = l.year
ORDER BY COALESCE(a.district, l.district);
```
